name: Matsuno Nariyuki
source:
The husband of Matsuno Mikoto. Ever since he was fired from his company, he is working part time at the convenience store. Even though his wife Mikoto constantly reminds him to look for a proper job, he avoids the issue most of the time and spends his free time fishing or gambling.

He incurred a large debt due to gambling, but keeps it a secret to his wife. Because Fukuda didn't add any interest and isn't exactly pressuring him to pay, he doesn't seem to care much about his debt. Unknown to him, his wife is working extra hours to pay for his debt.
